[P2] Resolve the untested caller contract in the design

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is unmet for this event filter. The PR adds no caller tests, and existing workflow tests never read this file. Removing `synchronize`, for example, would not fail those tests but would prevent pushes from restoring `needs-review`. The cited upstream labeling tests and actionlint do not establish coverage of this repository’s event subscriptions. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and agree on validation of the caller contract, as required by rule 9.
